notes: Explicit #DDDDDD text on the shape's own explicit #FFFFFF solid fill. Ground truth by construction: relative luminance of #DDDDDD is 0.723 and of #FFFFFF is 1.0, so the WCAG ratio is 1.05/0.773 = 1.36, under the calibrated 2.0 threshold. Both colors are explicit RGB, so no resolution chain is involved.
